verdict.rationale: Qdrant is documented as a vector search engine for storing and searching vectors with payloads. The quickstart shows the distance metric set per collection (`distance=Distance.DOT`), and community users report the core search is fast and accurate. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the ANN index (e.g., HNSW) and its tuning, the full list of supported distance metrics beyond DOT, and independent benchmark corroboration of search quality.
